Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. American insurance associations donate $1.1 million to AIDS research 2. Estate of Rock Hudson sues Hudson's alleged ex-lover, Marc Christian 3. Gay and Lesbian Task Force co-director, Rosemary Kuropat, resigns 4. Coverage of Bowers v Hardwick 5. Idaho attempted to introduce a bill to prohibit teachers from discussing homosexuality in a positive light 6. Oklahoma's sodomy law ruled unconstitutional but only regarding non-gay sex 7. Outing closeted homosexuals who are publically anti-gay COMMERCIAL: Commodore Plus 4 8. New Jersey wishes for Gay Rights Bill similar to New York City's 9. Gay Health Report 10. Discussion of apartment leases after AIDS-related deaths 11. Event announcement COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 12. Sports Report 13. Outreach: Conversations with GMHC: Interview with Joseph Foulon, a GMHC Hotline assistant, member of PWA Coalition, and an organizer of the NYC AIDS walk 14. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. This Week in Gay History with Jeff Bixby COMMERCIAL: E-Z Trim exercise equipment 2. Interview with Jaime Humberto Hermosillo and Marco Antonio Treviño, director and star of "Dona Herlinda and her Son" COMMERCIAL: SF AIDS Foundation 3. Pop and Circumstance: music news, video clips 4. Sybil Bruncheon, tidbits COMMERCIAL: The Monster
